source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The three added TLS1.3 names map to security.tls13 enable preferences. The existing callback passes the negation of each policy value to setAndLockPref. The inspected simple-pref case does not list these three additions; no direct TLS1.3 assertion or negotiated-cipher result is claimed.
title: DisabledCiphers maps three TLS1.3 names to negated enable preferences
